## TL Economic Intelligence

I co-run [TL Economic Intelligence](https://tleconomicintel.substack.com) with Titus Ojo. We build open economic data tools and write about what they show.

::: {.writing-list}
- [Remove UK-bound metals and Canada's record low export concentration disappears](https://tleconomicintel.substack.com/p/remove-uk-bound-metals-and-canadas) [8 Oct 2026]{.meta}
- [Canada's export concentration holds at a record low as August's monthly reading rebounds](https://tleconomicintel.substack.com/p/canadas-export-concentration-holds) [6 Oct 2026]{.meta}
- [Canada's export concentration hits a record low, and one market carries the gains](https://tleconomicintel.substack.com/p/canadas-export-concentration-hits) [2 Oct 2026]{.meta}
- [Tracking Canada's export diversification](https://tleconomicintel.substack.com/p/tracking-canadas-export-diversification) [27 May 2026]{.meta}
:::

**Tool:** the [Canadian Export Concentration Intelligence Tool](https://tleconomicintel.com/hhi/) tracks how concentrated Canada's exports are by market, product and province.
